title: Minecraft
imageHint: The iconic green pixelated mob that quietly approaches and explodes - every player's nightmare
description: A deep dive into the blocky world of Minecraft - from basic crafting to advanced redstone engineering.

questions.question: What is the name of the green explosive mob that silently approaches players?
What material do you need to craft a pickaxe handle?
In which dimension do you find Nether Wart, essential for brewing potions?
What is the maximum level of enchantment you can apply to most tools and weapons without combining enchanted books?
What redstone component can store and release a redstone signal, essential for creating memory circuits and pulse limiters?

connections.trigger: Both involve developmental progression, creativity, and building foundational skills through hands-on learning
Both are educational content designed for children and families

familyRequest.notes: Cross-generational gaming knowledge from basic to advanced
